quests.title: Caravan Escort Mission
quests.description: A trading caravan requests an armed escort through dangerous territory.
quests.synopsis: The Black Flotilla's trading caravan is traveling through Sector 6, a known raider territory. They offer payment in exchange for armed escort.

choices.consequences: The caravan reaches its destination safely, and you receive payment. However, the raiders may seek revenge.
The caravan is ambushed, and the Black Flotilla blames you for the loss. Your reputation suffers.

choices.text: Ambush the caravan and steal their goods
choices.consequences: The caravan is robbed, but the Black Flotilla vows revenge. Raiders may now target your bunker.

quests.title: Experimental Drug Trial
quests.description: Dr. Vasquez proposes testing an experimental drug on a terminally ill survivor.
quests.synopsis: Dr. Elena Vasquez has developed an experimental drug that could cure radiation sickness. She proposes testing it on Marcus Olejnik, who is terminally ill.

choices.consequences: The drug works! Marcus recovers, and Dr. Vasquez gains prestige. However, the drug has unknown long-term side effects.
Marcus dies, and Dr. Vasquez is devastated. Survivors question the ethics of refusing to try new treatments.

choices.text: Force Marcus to take the drug
choices.consequences: Marcus recovers, but survivors are horrified by the forced treatment. Trust in leadership erodes.

quests.title: Survivor Exile Decision
quests.description: A survivor has broken a critical rule and must be exiled for the safety of the group.
quests.synopsis: Jamie has been stealing food from the bunker's storage. The survivors must decide whether to exile them or give them a second chance.

choices.consequences: Jamie is exiled, but survivors are divided. Some may leave in protest, while others feel justice has been served.

choices.text: Forgive Jamie and assign community service
choices.consequences: Jamie is forgiven and assigned community service. Survivors respect the decision, and morale improves.
The theft continues, and survivors grow resentful. Some may start stealing for themselves.

quests.title: Radiation Storm Shelter Plan
quests.description: Prepare the bunker for an impending radiation storm.
quests.synopsis: Meteorologists predict a severe radiation storm in 72 hours. The bunker must prepare by sealing the air filters, stocking supplies, and assigning shelter duties.

choices.consequences: The bunker survives the storm with minimal casualties. Survivors are relieved and grateful.
The bunker suffers some radiation exposure, but no one is critically injured. Survivors are uneasy about the bunker's readiness.
The storm hits, and survivors suffer radiation exposure. Some may not survive.

quests.title: Survivor Leadership Election
quests.description: Hold an election to determine the bunker's new leader.
quests.synopsis: With your leadership in question, the survivors propose holding an election to determine the bunker's new leader.

choices.consequences: You lose the election and step down as leader. The survivors elect Marcus Olejnik as the new leader.
The survivors are divided. Some may leave the bunker, while others stage a coup.

choices.text: Rig the election to ensure your victory
choices.consequences: You win the election, but survivors resent the rigged result. Trust in leadership erodes.

quests.title: Food Storage Reorganization
quests.description: Reorganize the bunker's food storage to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
quests.synopsis: The survivors propose reorganizing the food storage to reduce waste and improve efficiency. This will require labor and time but could save resources in the long run.

choices.consequences: The reorganization is successful. Food waste is reduced, and the bunker's food supply lasts longer.

choices.text: Reorganize only the most critical areas
choices.consequences: The reorganization is partially successful. Some food is saved, but much is still wasted.
The survivors are disappointed. Food waste continues, and morale drops as resources dwindle.

quests.title: Survivor Skill Training Program
quests.description: Establish a comprehensive training program to improve survivors' skills and efficiency.
quests.synopsis: The survivors propose a comprehensive training program to improve everyone's skills and efficiency. This will require time and resources but could greatly benefit the bunker in the long run.

choices.consequences: The training program is successful. Survivors' skills improve, and the bunker operates more efficiently.
The program is partially successful. Critical roles improve, but many survivors remain untrained.
The survivors are disappointed. Survivors' skills remain stagnant, and morale drops.

quests.title: Raider Siege Defense
quests.description: Your bunker is under siege by a raider faction. Defend or negotiate?
quests.synopsis: The raiders of Sector 5 have surrounded your bunker and are demanding tribute. If you refuse, they will attack. The bunker must decide whether to defend or negotiate.

choices.consequences: The raiders are repelled, but the bunker suffers damage and casualties. Survivors are shaken but proud.
The raiders accept the tribute and leave. Survivors are relieved but resentful of the payment.
The raiders take control of the bunker. Survivors are enslaved or killed. Your bunker is lost.

quests.title: Medical Quarantine Decision
quests.description: A survivor has contracted a mysterious illness. Do you quarantine them or risk spreading the disease?
quests.synopsis: Alex has contracted a mysterious illness. Symptoms include fever, coughing, and weakness. The bunker must decide whether to quarantine Alex or risk spreading the disease.

choices.consequences: Alex is quarantined, and the disease does not spread. Survivors respect the decision, and morale improves.
The disease spreads. Several survivors fall ill, and one dies. Survivors question the leadership's decision.

choices.text: Exile Alex to prevent spreading the disease
choices.consequences: Alex is exiled, but survivors are horrified by the decision. Trust in leadership erodes.

quests.title: Survivor Memory Loss Crisis
quests.description: A survivor is experiencing severe memory loss. Do you help them or exile them?
quests.synopsis: Jamie has begun experiencing severe memory loss. They forget their own name and cannot perform basic tasks. The bunker must decide whether to help them or exile them.

choices.text: Help Jamie with their memory loss
choices.consequences: Jamie's memory improves slightly, but they are never the same. Survivors respect the effort, and morale improves.

choices.text: Exile Jamie for the safety of the group
choices.consequences: Jamie is exiled, but survivors are horrified by the decision. Trust in leadership erodes, and some may leave.
Jamie's condition worsens. They become a burden on the group, and morale drops as survivors grow resentful.

quests.title: Air Filter Upgrade
quests.description: Upgrade the bunker's air filtration system to improve air quality and reduce radiation exposure.
quests.synopsis: The survivors propose upgrading the bunker's air filtration system to improve air quality and reduce radiation exposure. This will require time and resources but could save lives in the long run.

choices.consequences: The upgrade is successful. Air quality improves, and radiation exposure is reduced. Survivors are grateful.
The upgrade is partially successful. Air quality improves slightly, but radiation exposure remains a concern.
The survivors are disappointed. Air quality remains poor, and morale drops as survivors suffer from respiratory issues.

quests.title: Survivor Art Project
quests.description: A group of survivors wants to start an art project to boost morale and creativity.
quests.synopsis: A group of survivors, led by Alex, proposes starting an art project to boost morale and creativity. The project will require resources and time but could greatly improve the bunker's atmosphere.

choices.consequences: The art project is a success. Morale improves, and survivors feel a renewed sense of creativity and hope.
The survivors are disappointed. Morale drops as survivors feel their creative needs are unappreciated.
The art project is completed, but survivors resent the forced participation. Morale drops, and some may leave.

quests.title: Technology Sharing Agreement
quests.description: A nearby settlement offers a technology sharing agreement in exchange for food and medicine.
quests.synopsis: The Meridian Compact offers a technology sharing agreement. In exchange for food and medicine, they will provide pre-war technology and blueprints.

choices.consequences: The agreement is successful. The bunker gains access to valuable technology, and relations with the Meridian Compact improve.
The Meridian Compact is disappointed but understand. Future collaborations may be difficult.
The Meridian Compact discovers your deception and cuts off all future trade. Your reputation suffers greatly.
